snapshot.purpose: Whitelisted fictional values and historical identifiers; not an automatic database import or a new journey.

replay_rules: Use a fresh fictional Academy profile for new recordings. Existing profiles retain their source pins, credentials, storage and saved history. Never reset or overwrite a department to match historical IDs.
Use normal signed-in UI operations. Record each fresh save, reopen and resulting state; historical timestamps and IDs identify evidence rather than values to copy into a live execution.
Keep credentials, runtime configuration, provider tokens, generated database files and private audio links outside public source and captures.
No real journey, live personnel occupancy, operational hazard or provider alert delivery is represented by these fictional examples.

steps: Weather Alerts > Settings: keep global alerts, automatic severity messages and call integration disabled.

Create the named Illinois NWS source with area filter ["IL"], initially 15-minute interval, inactive. Save, reopen, change to 30 minutes and verify the saved interval. Do not infer polling from OK; the recorded source remains Never Polled.
Create Downtown support zone at 41.8781,-87.6298, initially 5-mile radius, primary and active. Save, reopen and change radius to 8 miles. Disable and verify Inactive; enable and verify Active.
Select the saved Community support route in Unit and review its two stops. Keep automatic GPS arrival disabled for this manual software exercise.
Start a new execution. Check In at Community point A; verify In Progress and Check Out. Check Out; verify progress and the next pending stop.
Check In and Check Out at Community point B; verify both stops completed and 100 percent. End Route through the visible confirmation.
Verify Unit no longer has the active execution, then inspect Core execution history for Completed, 2/2 stops, saved start/end and each stop time.
operations.evidence_note: The primary completed run is 753b31f0-9092-4631-95b9-44a7722f9eed. The clean Stops Completed banner pickup is from a separate third rehearsal, f71906df-9386-4f87-9e3e-1ed932471448, with the same plan and 2/2 stops but not yet ended. Its banner is not evidence of the primary timestamps.

steps: Core Routes > Directions: inspect the route overview, its departure leg, second leg and return leg. Compare travel time with the additional configured dwell time.
Review the stop summary, contacts and notes. In Unit, inspect View Route and then start the saved route.

Open the active Directions view and inspect the actual provider distance, time, destination and No traffic data message. Open in Maps is shown as an available action; an external navigation trip was not recorded.
operations.limits: Core includes departure and return to station plus dwell, whereas Unit guidance uses the selected route endpoints. Estimates may change on replay. No GPS journey or traffic claim.

steps: Mapping > Layers > New Layer: enter the fictional Outreach staging example name and choose blue. Draw a rectangle with its normal first/second corner interaction, then place one marker. Save Add Layer.
Verify the saved row has two items; reopen to inspect retained geometry and Display on Map by Default. Clear that default, save, and reopen to verify it stayed clear.
On Mapping, switch only Outreach staging on and off while leaving Community staging checked. Reload and verify the retained individual visibility state.
operations.exclusion_reason: Those earlier main-map captures exposed a shared empty PostgreSQL layer identifier; fresh 018–021 show the repaired independent controls. Original evidence bytes remain retained.

steps: Custom Maps > Community coordination centre > Ground floor > Edit Regions: inspect Briefing room - training, with Searchable true and Dispatchable false.
Clear Searchable and save. On New Call, search Briefing in Indoor Location and verify no matching result. Restore Searchable, save and verify the room returns.
In a separate New Call exercise, select the room, set and verify the separate outdoor latitude/longitude reference, and select Save as pending before submitting.
Verify the saved pending call, open it and use Update Call to inspect the retained room/floor reference. No actual dispatch is sent.
operations.evidence_note: The recorded call was saved before the searchability round trip; the instructional order groups the room search controls before the separate call example. Searchable controls this lookup independently of Dispatchable.

steps: Add the dedicated KML and KMZ import Data Layer to the fictional custom map.
Open Import, explicitly choose that target layer and choose academy-geospatial-assembly.kml. Import and verify Complete in history.
Reselect the target after the form resets, choose academy-geospatial-access.kmz and verify both imports Complete.
Reselect the target, import academy-geospatial-empty.kml, and inspect the expected Failed row explaining that no supported placemarks were found.
Open Edit Regions for the dedicated layer. Inspect both separate polygons and their Custom, Searchable and Dispatchable properties without changing them.
On unsaved New Call, search training under Indoor Location and verify both imported names are available. Do not submit a call.
operations.expected_negative_case: A valid KML container with no supported placemarks is rejected; its Failed history row is not hidden.

steps: Unit Maps > Indoor Maps: select the fictional Community coordination centre; verify the Ground floor tab and actual floor image/room overlay.
Select the shaded Briefing room area and inspect its saved name/description.
Switch GIS import, inspect the two regions and open Training room - import details.
Enter Equipment in the viewer search; inspect the matching equipment region and its detail card. Close the card, remove the search text and verify both overlays return.
Switch KML and KMZ import and inspect each saved region card. Dispatch to this zone is available on dispatchable references but is not clicked in this exercise.
Return to Maps and reopen the same indoor entry; verify the saved ground-floor reference. No real occupant or arrival is represented.

source_findings: Legacy room geometry is stored in PixelGeometry while the API zone projection reads GeoGeometry.
Legacy floor bounds are null; the client needs non-zero georeferenced image bounds and authorized image access.
The current ordinary personnel/unit location contracts do not identify an indoor floor or room, and this viewer has no live-occupancy overlay.
live_indoor_recording_limit.earlier_observation: The Unit recording viewer can list maps and floors after API contract adaptation, but it does not render the floor image or region overlay. No blank viewer is qualified as a tutorial.
live_indoor_recording_limit.actual_observation: The later isolated compatibility pack successfully renders the actual floor image and saved geographic room/region overlays. Normal-UI details, filtering, layer switches and reopening are recorded. The current viewer still has no live occupant or indoor personnel-floor tracking feed.
